databaseName.description: Unique name of database. Valid characters:  `0`-`9`, `A`-`Z`, `a`-`z`, `_` (underscore), `-` (hyphen), `:` (colon), and ' ' (space). Maximum length is 80 characters.

groupNames.description: Array of group names that identify the groups that may access the database.
